tickets.title: Complete beneficiary update checklist
tickets.text:
Use this checklist before submitting or recording beneficiary updates for the Mossbutton household education accounts:

- Confirm the account registration and account type requiring a beneficiary review for the Cloudberry Kite Education Plan 529 accounts for Lila and Theo Mossbutton.
- Verify current primary and contingent beneficiaries on file.
- Confirm full legal names, relationships, dates of birth if required, and allocation percentages.
- Check that total primary percentages equal 100% and total contingent percentages equal 100% when applicable.
- Identify whether spouse consent, trust documentation, or plan administrator approval is required.
- Confirm whether IRA, retirement plan, transfer-on-death, insurance, or annuity rules apply.
- Send the correct custodian or carrier form through the approved secure process.
- Save confirmation of submission and final acceptance in the client record.
- Note any estate planning follow-up needed with Jared Thimblefern, the attorney named in the household's estate planning records.

Review successor owner and beneficiary records for the Cloudberry Kite Education Plan 529 accounts in light of Lila Mossbutton starting college at Paper Otter University, Theo Mossbutton remaining a future beneficiary, and Alma Pebblefizz appearing as successor owner on at least one account record.
